svg.text: 1 Explorer: Page → Form → Control hierarchy (manual pp21,28).
2 Document: page tabs above; five mode tabs below; current draft distinct from generated output (pp21,134).
3 Toolbox: focused Forms / Controls / HTML commands; bounded modal wizards (p29).
4 Properties: contextual Format / Data / Events; selected type/name and explicit labels (p29).
5 Messages: persistent lower dock with object-linked diagnostics (p21).
Intentional modernization: legible labels, restrained chrome, authored/generated ownership, isolated Preview; no permanent wizard.
